description:
Responsible for Dolby Atmos and other equalizer stuff (accessible from the Settings app).
Needed by Adapt Sound (com.sec.hearingadjust) which is a pretty useful feature.
NOTE: If the app crashes regularly, even when you don't use Dolby or other features, check to see if you have "com.samsung.android.scpm" installed & enabled. If not, try installing/enabling it.
